title: Finance Head
description:
The Finance Head will lead Kripa Electronics' entire finance function. This person will be a strategic partner to the leadership team on growth, profitability, capital allocation, and risk management. The role combines hands-on financial stewardship with a forward-looking view of the business, including readiness for fundraising, expansion, or a future listing. Key Responsibilities Strategy & Leadership Partner with the MD and leadership team to shape business strategy, annual operating plans, and long-term financial goals. Evaluate expansion opportunities, new product lines, capex decisions, and potential M&A or partnerships. Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing finance, accounts, and compliance team. Financial Planning & Analysis Own budgeting, forecasting, and MIS reporting, with clear insight into product, channel, and plant-level profitability. Drive cost optimization across procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and overheads. Develop KPIs and dashboards to track working capital, margins, and cash flow. Treasury & Funding Manage cash flow, liquidity, and working capital, including inventory, receivables, and supplier credit. Maintain strong relationships with banks, NBFCs, and investors. Negotiate credit lines, term loans, and trade finance. Lead equity or debt fundraising initiatives as required. Manage foreign exchange exposure related to component imports and exports. Accounting, Tax & Compliance Ensure accurate, timely financial statements in line with applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IFRS). Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, customs duties, and transfer pricing where applicable. Coordinate statutory, internal, and tax audits. Ensure full regulatory and corporate law compliance. Governance, Risk & Systems Establish robust internal controls, policies, and a risk management framework. Lead ERP implementation or upgrades and digitize finance processes. Report to the Board and audit committee on financial performance and risks. Qualifications & Experience Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory. An MBA (Finance), CPA, or CMA is an added advantage. 15+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in a CFO, Finance Head, or similar senior leadership role. Experience in electronics, consumer durables, or manufacturing is strongly preferred. Proven track record in fundraising, banking relationships, and working capital management. Strong knowledge of import/export finance, GST, customs, and forex management. Exposure to IPO readiness, PE investment, or M&A transactions is desirable. Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Tally Prime. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with strong commercial acumen Leadership and team-building ability High integrity and sound judgment Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills An analytical, data-driven approach to decision-making

description:
Job Summary Role: Manager- Finance & Admin (Governance, Compliance & Operations), New Delhi Experience: 5+ years About the role: We are hiring one person to run the institutional backbone of the organisation: board governance, statutory and financial compliance, grant management and day-to-day administration. Based in New Delhi, full-time, reporting to the Director. Why this role matters As we grow, our credibility depends as much on how well we are run as on the quality of our research. This role keeps the organisation compliant, well-governed and audit-ready, so the research team can focus on its work. You will be the go-to person for the board, auditors, funders and regulators, and will build systems that scale with us. Key responsibilities Regulatory and tax compliance Keep 12A and 80G registrations current, including renewals, and issue Form 10BE donor certificates and file Form 10BD. Manage CSR-1 registration and documentation for CSR-funded projects. Handle income tax filings for the organisation (ITR-7, audit report in Form 10B/10BB), TDS deductions, returns and certificates, and GST where applicable. If the organisation holds FCRA registration: maintain the designated FCRA account, utilisation records and quarterly and annual returns (FC-4), and track renewal timelines. Ensure compliance with labour laws: PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, POSH committee and annual report. Maintain a compliance calendar so no filing or renewal is missed. Finance and accounts Oversee bookkeeping, monthly closes and bank reconciliations, working with an external accountant where needed. Prepare the annual budget with the Executive Director and track spend against it monthly. Run payroll, vendor payments and reimbursements, with clear approval workflows. Manage cash flow and fund accounting across restricted and unrestricted funds. Coordinate statutory and internal audits, and any funder or due-diligence audits. Prepare financial reports for management, the board and the annual report. Grant Management Support proposal development with budgets, budget narratives and organisational documents. Review grant agreements for financial, reporting and compliance terms, and flag risks before signing. Track all grants: deliverables, reporting deadlines, spend against budget, and restrictions. Prepare or coordinate financial and narrative reports to funders, working with programme leads. Maintain funder due-diligence documentation and relationships on the operations side. Board governance and company secretary Plan and run board and general meetings: calendars, notices, agendas, board papers, minutes and resolutions under the Companies Act, 2013 and Secretarial Standards. Maintain statutory registers, the minute book and the record of directors disclosures and interests. File annual and event-based returns with the Registrar of Companies (e.g. AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, DIR-3 KYC, changes in directors or registered office), working with the company secretary in practice. Help the board review and update governance policies: conflict of interest, whistleblower, POSH, data protection, delegation of authority. Keep board members briefed on compliance status and governance risks. Administration and operations Run office administration: lease, vendors, IT, insurance, assets and procurement. Manage contracts with consultants, research partners and service providers. Supervise any administrative or finance support staff or interns. Who we are looking for Required 5-7 years of experience across finance, compliance, governance and administration, with at least part of it in the non-profit sector. Hands-on knowledge of Section 8 company governance and compliance under the Companies Act, 2013, including board processes and ROC filings. Working knowledge of non-profit tax and regulatory requirements: 12A/80G, CSR-1, TDS, and FCRA. Experience managing grants from institutional donors, foundations or CSR funders, including budgeting and financial reporting. Comfort with accounting software (e.g. Tally, Zoho Books) and strong spreadsheet skills. A graduate or postgraduate degree in commerce, finance, business administration, law or a related field. Clear written and verbal communication in English and Hindi, including with board members and funders Able to explain compliance requirements simply to colleagues who are not specialists. Comfortable working independently in a small team and doing hands-on work as well as oversight. Preferred: Experience in a policy research, advocacy or think-tank organisation, ideally in law, justice or governance. A professional qualification such as CA (inter or final), CS, CMA or an MBA in finance. Experience setting up systems and policies in a small or growing organisation.

Job Description: Account Payable Executive Department: Finance & Accounts
 Reporting To: Accounts Manager / Finance Manager
 Job Purpose Manage day-to-day accounts payable activities, ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, maintain vendor accounts, and ensure payments are processed within agreed timelines while complying with company policies and statutory requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities Vendor Invoice Processing Receive, verify, and process vendor invoices, bills, and supporting documents. Check invoices against purchase orders (POs), work orders, contracts, and goods receipt notes (GRNs), wherever applicable. Ensure accuracy of invoice amounts, GST details, vendor information, and other supporting documents. Identify and resolve discrepancies in invoices before processing payments. Ensure timely booking of expenses and liabilities in the accounting system. Vendor Reconciliation Perform regular vendor ledger reconciliation and resolve outstanding discrepancies. Obtain vendor statements and reconcile them with company records. Follow up with vendors and internal departments regarding pending invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment differences. Maintain accurate vendor balances and ageing reports. Payment Processing Prepare vendor payment proposals as per agreed credit terms and company payment schedules. Coordinate with the Finance team for payment approvals and timely disbursement. Track due dates and ensure payments are processed within approved timelines. Maintain payment records and share remittance details with vendors wherever required. GST and Statutory Compliance Verify GSTIN, invoice details, and applicable GST rates. Support reconciliation of purchase records with GSTR-2B and follow up on discrepancies affecting input tax credit (ITC). Ensure proper documentation and accounting treatment for TDS deductions under applicable provisions. Coordinate with the tax and compliance teams for statutory reporting and audit requirements. Reporting and Documentation Maintain vendor master data and ensure supporting documents are available. Prepare accounts payable ageing, outstanding liability, and payment status reports. Maintain records of invoices, approvals, payment vouchers, and other relevant documents. Support internal audits, statutory audits, and financial closing activities. Assist in monthly expense provisions and outstanding liability reconciliation. Internal Coordination Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, HR, and other departments for invoice approvals and supporting documents. Follow up with internal stakeholders to resolve pending bills and payment-related queries. Ensure compliance with company policies, approval matrices, and financial controls. Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field. Additional qualifications in Finance or Accounting will be an advantage. Experience 4 to 7 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Vendor Management, or Finance & Accounts. Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or service-based organizations will be preferred. Technical Skills Working knowledge of MS Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and data reconciliation. Knowledge of accounting software or ERP systems such as Tally, SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms. Understanding of GST, TDS, vendor reconciliation, and invoice processing. Good analytical skills and attention to detail. Behavioural Competencies Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple invoices and payment deadlines. Problem-solving and reconciliation skills. Integrity, accountability, and adherence to financial controls. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices. Percentage of invoices processed within the defined turnaround time. Accuracy and timely completion of vendor reconciliations. Reduction in overdue and disputed invoices. Timely submission of payment proposals. Compliance with GST, TDS, and internal audit requirements. Accuracy of accounts payable ageing and month-end closing reports.

The candidate will be responsible for achieving revenue and profitability targets, developing new markets, improving operational efficiency, strengthening customer relationships, and building a high-performing sales and operations team across multiple locations.
 
 
 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Sales & Business Development 
 Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets. Drive sales growth across existing branches, dealers, distributors, contractors, builders and industrial customers. Identify new markets, business opportunities and potential customers. Expand the dealer and distributor network across assigned territories. Build strong relationships with key accounts, institutional buyers, contractors and project customers. Monitor sales pipelines, quotations, order conversion, collections and customer retention. Analyse competitor activities, market pricing and product demand. Improve gross margins, sales productivity and overall profitability. 
 B. Branch Operations Management 
 Manage and monitor the performance of 3-5 or more branches and their teams. Establish branch-wise sales, profitability and operational targets. Ensure smooth coordination between sales, procurement, production, logistics, warehousing and finance. Monitor stock availability, inventory levels, dispatches, delivery schedules and order fulfilment. Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all branches. Improve operational efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs, wastage and inventory losses. Conduct regular branch visits and performance reviews. 
 
 C. New Branch Expansion 
 Identify and evaluate opportunities for opening new branches, depots and distribution centres. Assess market potential, competition, customer demand and branch viability. Develop business plans and launch strategies for new locations. Establish local sales teams, dealer networks and operational systems. Ensure new branches achieve agreed revenue and profitability milestones. 
 D. Team Leadership & Performance Management 
 Lead, motivate and develop branch managers, sales managers and operations teams. Set clear individual and team performance targets. Recruit, train and retain high-performing employees. Conduct periodic performance reviews and implement corrective actions. Build a performance-driven culture with accountability for sales, collections and profitability. 
 E. Financial & Business Control 
 Prepare and manage annual budgets and business plans. Monitor revenue, gross margins, operating expenses and branch profitability. Ensure timely customer collections and effective credit control. Coordinate with finance teams on receivables, outstanding payments and credit limits. Prepare monthly management reports and recommend actions to improve business performance. 
 F. MIS, Reporting & Business Planning 
 Review daily, weekly and monthly sales and operations reports. Track branch-wise performance against budgets and targets. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and take timely corrective action. Provide regular business updates, forecasts and expansion plans to the Managing Director. Implement effective reporting systems and use ERP/CRM tools to improve visibility and control. 
 3. Candidate Profile 
 8-15 years of relevant professional experience in sales and operations. Proven experience in building materials, roofing sheets, PUF sandwich panels, steel, metal products, industrial products or a similar B2B business. Experience managing multiple branches, preferably 3-5 or more locations. Demonstrated ability to increase sales revenue, improve profitability and develop new markets. Strong understanding of dealer/distributor management, project sales, institutional sales and B2B customer acquisition. Experience in inventory management, logistics, collections, credit control and branch-level profitability. Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical and problem-solving skills. Willingness to travel regularly across assigned locations. Graduate degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering or a related field preferred. An MBA in Sales, Marketing or Operations is an advantage. 
 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Performance will be evaluated on the following parameters: Achievement of sales and revenue targets. Year-on-year sales growth. Gross margin and operating profitability. New customer acquisition and dealer/distributor expansion. Branch-wise sales and profitability improvement. Customer collections and reduction in overdue receivables. Inventory turnover and reduction in stock losses. Order fulfilment and delivery performance. Productivity and performance of sales and operations teams. Successful establishment and ramp-up of new branches, where applicable. 
 5. Key Competencies 
 Business ownership and commercial acumen. Strong sales leadership and execution. Multi-location operations management. Strategic planning and market development. Financial discipline and profitability orientation. Team building and performance management. Data-driven decision-making. Customer relationship management. High integrity, accountability and execution focus. 
 6. Compensation 
Competitive salary and performance-linked incentives, commensurate with the candidate's experience, current compensation and demonstrated ability to deliver business growth.
 
 7. Application Process 
Interested candidates should submit their updated CV, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and a brief summary of their experience in managing multiple branches and achieving sales growth.

Regional Category Manager Vendor Partnerships - Savomart 
Location: Kerala, Delhi, Kolkata 
Reports to: Category Head 
 About the Role Savomart is looking for a seasoned commercial leader who has sat on the other side of the table and now wants to build category and vendor strength from within a retailer. You will own the FMCG category P&L (foods, home care, personal care), negotiate and run joint business plans with large suppliers, and use your field-level understanding of trade, distributors and in-store execution to lift sales, margin and availability across Savomart stores. This role suits someone with 15–20+ years in FMCG sales, modern trade and category management who knows how brands plan, price, promote and distribute, and can convert that knowledge into a sharper buying and merchandising engine for a regional retailer. 
 What You Will Own
1. Category P&L and growth own sales, gross margin and inventory health for FMCG categories (detergents, personal care, packaged foods and beverages). Build annual and quarterly category plans with SKU store-cluster level action plans. Drive growth of high-potential and future core segments and rationalize slow-moving SKUs.
2. Vendor and key account partnerships Lead annual trade terms, joint business plans, scheme negotiations and listing/delisting decisions with national and regional FMCG suppliers. Manage relationships at senior level with sales heads, key account managers and distributors of leading FMCG companies. Ensure timely claims, scheme settlement and funding of promotions.
3. Promotions, visibility and in-store execution Plan the promotional calendar with suppliers, including launches, displays, endcaps, POSM and store activations. Track planogram compliance, share of shelf, on-shelf availability and visibility scores across stores. Run supplier-funded launches of new brand innovations through the store network.
4. Supply chain and availability work with supply chain and warehouse teams on demand forecasts, stock plans, fill rates and replenishment cycles. Reduce out-of-stocks and ageing inventory using sell-out and market data.
5. Insights and analytics Use sales data, panel data (Nielsen/IMRB-type market insights) and competitor tracking to set pricing, assortment and promotion decisions. Produce weekly and monthly category dashboards for leadership.
6. Team leadership Lead and develop category managers, buyers and merchandising executives. Upskill store and field teams on product knowledge, selling points and competitor offerings through sessions and store immersions.
7. Growth initiatives Support expansion into new stores and clusters, private label opportunities and supplier-backed exclusives. Where relevant, evaluate and onboard digital and AI-enabled tools for forecasting, pricing and promotion analytics.

description:

 Job Summary 
 
If you are a Finance professional, Emerson has an exciting role for you! We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to work with our FP&A COE in Pune. 
The Senior FP&A Analyst role will support Emersons FLMC business activities in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, representing $400M+ in annual revenue. The role is complex, demanding and can be a career booster/accelerator for highly motivated finance professional.
 
 In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly take action in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.

Through our benefits, development opportunities, and an inclusive and safe work environment, we aim to create an organization our people are proud to represent.

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

At Emerson, youll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, lets go. Lets think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Lets go, together.

Customer Service and Client Relationships Ensure excellent customer service and a premium shopping experience for every customer. Build long-term customer relationships and encourage repeat purchases. Ensure staff have strong product knowledge, including watch brands, collections, features, warranty terms, and after-sales services. 4. Inventory and Merchandise Management Maintain accurate stock records and conduct regular physical stock counts. Monitor high-value inventory and ensure watches are securely stored and displayed. Ensure proper stock transfers, receiving, tagging, billing, and documentation. Investigate stock discrepancies, missing items, damages, and potential losses. Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products and coordinate replenishment with the relevant teams. Ensure all watches are handled, displayed, and stored according to brand and company guidelines. 5. Security and Loss Prevention Implement strict security measures for high-value watch merchandise. Ensure CCTV, alarms, access controls, and security systems are operational, with issues escalated promptly. Monitor cash handling, billing procedures, and end-of-shift cash reconciliation. Ensure proper key control and secure access to stockrooms, safes, and restricted areas. Conduct shift-wise stock and cash handovers wherever required. Report theft, suspected fraud, security incidents, and operational irregularities immediately. 6. Team Management and Development Train, coach, and supervise sales associates, cashiers, and other store personnel. Prepare and manage a rotational shift roster to ensure adequate staffing 24 hours a day. Ensure sufficient trained staff are available during night shifts, weekends, holidays, and peak business hours. Conduct regular performance reviews, team briefings, and product training sessions. Maintain discipline, teamwork, and accountability across all shifts. Ensure clear communication and proper handovers between outgoing and incoming teams. 7. 24/7 Shift Management and Operational Continuity Ensure uninterrupted store operations through effective manpower planning and shift allocation. Establish clear procedures for shift changes, including cash reconciliation, stock verification, pending customer issues, and incident reporting. Monitor night-shift operations and ensure that service quality, security, and store standards remain consistent. Develop contingency plans for staff absenteeism, emergencies, system failures, and security incidents. Ensure appropriate escalation procedures are followed during late-night and early-morning hours. Maintain compliance with applicable working-hour, overtime, weekly-off, and night-shift regulations. 8. Reporting and Administration Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and operational reports. Maintain records of attendance, stock movement, cash transactions, incidents, and customer complaints. Coordinate with finance, HR, merchandising, security, and supply chain teams. Monitor store expenses and ensure efficient use of operational resources. Ensure all required licences, records, and statutory compliance documents are maintained as applicable. Experience in watches, jewellery, luxury goods, electronics, or other high-value retail categories preferred. Previous experience managing rotational shifts or 24/7 retail operations is an advantage. Strong understanding of retail sales, inventory control, merchandising, and customer service. Familiarity with POS systems, inventory management software, MS Excel, and sales reporting tools. Required Skills and Competencies Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer-handling abilities. Sales-driven mindset with the ability to achieve business targets. Strong attention to detail and inventory accuracy. High integrity and awareness of loss prevention and security. Effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Flexibility to work rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. Ability to remain calm and manage emergencies during off-peak hours. Working Conditions The store operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The Store Manager must be available to oversee and support rotational shifts as per the business requirement. The role may require working nights, weekends, public holidays, and during peak sales periods. The position involves standing for extended periods, supervising store activities, and handling high-value merchandise. Weekly offs, working hours, and night-shift arrangements will be managed in accordance with company policy and applicable labour laws. Note: The Store Manager is accountable for the overall performance and operational continuity of the store. The roster should ensure 24/7 coverage through a properly staffed team, rather than requiring the Store Manager to work continuously around the clock.

description:
Note: Only candidates from Himachal Pradesh are eligible to apply for this position and have practical working experience in Himachal Pradesh. 
 
 Job Description 
 
 Accounts Department 
 Industry: Tourism / Travel / Hospitality Department: Accounts Finance Designation: Accounts Executive / Accountant Reporting To: Accounts Manager / Management 
 
 Job Summary 
 To manage the companys day-to-day accounting, financial transactions, billing, payments, collections, and financial records accurately and on time, while supporting the smooth financial operations of the tourism business. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 A. Daily Accounting 
 Maintain daily accounting entries in Tally/ERP/accounting software. Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Maintain cash and bank books. Check and verify invoices, bills, receipts, and supporting documents. Maintain proper records of company expenses. 
 
 B. Tour Travel Accounts 
 Prepare and verify invoices for tour packages, hotel bookings, transportation, and other travel services. Maintain customer-wise and booking-wise payment records. Track advance payments received from customers. Monitor pending customer payments and outstanding balances. Verify vendor bills for hotels, transporters, guides, agents, and other service providers. Maintain vendor-wise outstanding statements. Reconcile tour package costs with actual expenses. 
 
 C. Bank Cash Management 
 Prepare bank reconciliation statements. Monitor daily bank transactions. Maintain petty cash records. Verify cash receipts and payments. Ensure all cash and bank transactions are properly documented. 
 
 D. Receivables Payables 
 Follow up on outstanding customer payments. Maintain accounts receivable and payable reports. Process vendor payments after proper verification and approval. Ensure payments are made according to company policy and agreed terms. 
 
 E. GST Taxation Support 
 Maintain GST-related sales and purchase records. Assist in preparation of GST returns and other statutory reports. Maintain proper tax invoices and supporting documents. Coordinate with CA/tax consultants for taxation-related requirements. Maintain TDS records and assist with TDS compliance wherever applicable. 
 
 F. Salary Employee Accounts 
 Assist in monthly salary preparation. Maintain employee advances, deductions, incentives, and reimbursements. Verify employee expense claims and supporting bills. Maintain records related to full final settlement. 
 
 G. Financial Reporting 
 Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounting reports. Prepare outstanding reports for customers and vendors. Provide management with revenue, expense, and payment reports. Assist in monthly closing and preparation of financial statements. 
 
 Required Skills 
 Basic knowledge of accounting principles. Knowledge of Tally/ERP/accounting software. Good knowledge of MS Excel. Basic knowledge of GST, TDS, and taxation. Good calculation and analytical skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to maintain confidential financial information. Ability to work under deadlines. 
 
 Qualification Experience 
 Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / Equivalent accounting qualification. Experience: 1-4 years in accounts, any company. Candidates having good accounting knowledge and computer skills, email drafting skills.

description:
Were Hiring: Network & Production Support Engineers Enterprise IT Operations 
 20+ Openings | 3 - 20 Years of Experience | Multiple Levels Locations: Mumbai | Pune | Chandigarh | Gurugram | Noida | Delhi | Bengaluru | Hyderabad | Chennai
 Employment Type: Permanent | Contract
 Industry: Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra) Specific location, experience requirements, employment type, and work model may vary by position and role. 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking skilled Network Support, Production Support, and IT Operations Engineers with experience in telecom, ISP, enterprise network infrastructure, and mission-critical production environments. The ideal candidates will have hands-on expertise in IP/Ethernet networking, network equipment troubleshooting, fiber operations, NOC monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA). Depending on the role and seniority, responsibilities may also include application and infrastructure support, automation, performance optimization, service reliability, and team leadership. Candidates with experience in Tier 2/3 network support, telecom-grade NOC operations, fiber fault diagnosis, and enterprise IT operations are encouraged to apply. 
 Open Positions & Designations Network Support Engineer / L2 Support Engineer 3 5 Years Senior Network / Production Support Engineer (L3) 5 10 Years Technical Specialist / Support Lead – 8 – 12 Years Operations Manager / Service Delivery Manager – 10 – 15 Years Director of IT Operations / Head of Production Support – 15 – 20 Years Designation and experience requirements will depend on the specific opening. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Network Operations & Technical Support Provide L2/L3 technical support for network infrastructure, enterprise connectivity, and escalated customer incidents. Troubleshoot and restore Ethernet/IP circuits at service and circuit levels. Diagnose network connectivity, routing, switching, performance, and availability issues. Configure, install, maintain, and troubleshoot routers, switches, Network Interface Devices (NIDs), and related equipment. Work with networking platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Ciena, and Accedian. Monitor network health, alarms, and performance metrics in a 24x7 NOC environment. Coordinate with Core Engineering, Provisioning, Field Operations, and external vendors to restore services within agreed SLAs. 2. Network Protocols & Infrastructure Troubleshooting Diagnose and resolve issues involving BGP, MPLS, Ethernet switching, VLANs, STP, and LAG. Use network device CLI, SNMP-based tools, and vendor-specific Network Management Systems (NMS) for troubleshooting. Perform network isolation, fault diagnosis, performance analysis, and service restoration. Support critical hardware interventions, including core router, line card, and network component replacements. Troubleshoot telecom infrastructure and enterprise connectivity issues, with exposure to FTTx and DWDM considered an advantage. 3. Fiber Operations & Field Support Perform or coordinate fiber fault identification, testing, repair, and restoration activities. Support Outside Plant (OSP) fiber operations, maintenance, fiber splicing, and fiber network troubleshooting. Assist field technicians and engineers with fiber fault diagnosis and OTDR testing. Conduct RFC 2544 testing and validate network throughput and circuit performance. Use diagnostic tools such as OTDR, iPerf, and Wireshark to identify and resolve network issues. Coordinate field interventions and ensure timely service restoration. 4. Production & Application Support Monitor and support enterprise applications, infrastructure services, and production systems in 24x7 environments. Perform incident triage, troubleshooting, and resolution within defined SLAs. Investigate application, database, operating system, infrastructure, and network-related incidents, according to role requirements. Execute operational runbooks, standard procedures, and recovery workflows. Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, database, and network engineering teams to resolve complex incidents. Support production deployments, release activities, change implementation, and post-deployment validation where applicable. 5. Incident, Problem & Change Management Manage incidents, problems, and changes in accordance with ITIL practices and operational procedures. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and major service disruptions. Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve service availability and reliability. Follow escalation matrices and engage senior engineering teams or third-party vendors for critical hardware and software issues. Maintain incident tickets, troubleshooting records, resolution details, RCA reports, and service restoration timelines. Participate in major incident management and post-incident reviews. 6. Monitoring, Automation & Service Reliability Monitor network, application, infrastructure, and system performance using relevant monitoring and observability platforms. Work with tools such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog, and Nagios, depending on the environment. Use Python, Shell, Bash, PowerShell, or Ansible to automate repetitive support tasks and operational workflows. Identify performance bottlenecks, recurring alerts, capacity issues, and service reliability risks. Contribute to continuous service improvement, operational efficiency, and preventive maintenance. Support DevOps and SRE practices where applicable to the role. 7. Customer Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration Communicate professionally with enterprise customers regarding incident status, troubleshooting progress, and resolution timelines. Provide timely updates to customers, internal stakeholders, and management during critical incidents. Coordinate with Field Operations, Provisioning, Core Engineering, Application Support, and Service Delivery teams. Ensure effective handovers between shifts and maintain accurate operational documentation. Remain calm and effective while handling high-priority incidents in high-availability environments. 8. Leadership & Service Delivery (Senior Roles) Lead technical support teams and manage operational delivery across shifts or locations. Define and track SLAs, KPIs, incident trends, service availability, and operational performance. Oversee major incident response, escalations, RCA, and service improvement initiatives. Drive automation, standardization, capacity planning, and operational cost optimization. Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with senior stakeholders on reliability and service delivery strategies. 
 Technical Skills & Tools Networking & Telecom IP Networking, Ethernet, Routing, Switching, BGP, MPLS, VLAN, STP, LAG Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Ciena, Accedian Routers, Switches, NIDs, CLI, SNMP, Network Management Systems Fiber Optics, OSP, OTDR, Fiber Splicing, RFC 2544, iPerf, Wireshark Telecom/ISP NOC Operations, FTTx, DWDM Production & Application Support Application Support, Production Support, L2/L3 Troubleshooting Incident, Problem, and Change Management Root Cause Analysis (RCA), SLA Management, Service Restoration Linux/Unix, Windows Server, Infrastructure and Database Support Monitoring & ITSM Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog, Nagios ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, PagerDuty Automation & DevOps Python, Shell Scripting, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible Jenkins, Git, Docker, Kubernetes AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP exposure, depending on the role Specific tools and technologies will vary by position. Candidates are not expected to have expertise in every tool listed. 
 Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant experience in network operations, telecom/ISP support, NOC operations, production support, application support, or enterprise IT operations, depending on the position. Strong hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Experience working in 24x7 operational environments and managing incidents within defined SLAs. Field technician experience of 1 – 2 years, preferably in telecom or fiber network operations, for field-focused positions. Strong verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams. Leadership and service delivery experience for senior and managerial positions. 
 Preferred Certifications Cisco CCNA / CCNP Juniper JNCIA / JNCIS Nokia networking certifications ITIL Foundation / Intermediate SRE certifications AWS / Azure operations certifications 
 Who Should Apply? We welcome applications from professionals with experience in: Network Operations and Telecom/ISP Support L2/L3 Network Engineering and NOC Operations Fiber Operations, OSP, and Field Network Support Production and Application Support Infrastructure Operations and Service Reliability Technical Support Leadership and IT Service Delivery 
 Multiple openings are available across experience levels and locations. Candidates will be considered based on their relevant technical expertise, experience, and suitability for the specific role.

Monitor operational performance through dashboards, MIS and management reviews. Identify risks, bottlenecks and dependencies and drive timely resolution. Ensure adherence to defined processes, policies and client requirements.

Conduct regular performance reviews and identify improvement opportunities. Develop high-potential employees and create a strong succession pipeline. Drive employee engagement, retention and team motivation. Address performance, attendance and behavioral issues through appropriate interventions. 
 3. Capacity & Workforce Management 
 Plan capacity based on current and projected business requirements. Manage the learning curve during new program launches and ensure effective transition to steady-state operations. Optimize resource allocation across teams and workflows.

Develop targeted interventions including coaching, mentoring, re-training and performance improvement plans. Use operational data to identify process and workflow inefficiencies. Conduct time-and-motion or process studies where required to identify productivity improvement opportunities. Identify and replicate best practices from high-performing teams.

Ensure productivity and efficiency initiatives do not compromise quality. Promote a culture of First Time Right and continuous quality improvement.
 
 6. Client & Stakeholder Management

Work with Technology and Process Excellence teams to identify automation opportunities. Use data and root-cause analysis to eliminate recurring operational issues. Drive continuous improvement initiatives with measurable business impact. 
 8. Governance & Compliance

Ensure audit readiness and timely closure of audit observations. Drive compliance across production, quality and support functions.

The Practice- A Brief Sketch: Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance. You-ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making. Digital Thread Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making. Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems. Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration. Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain. Connected Twins Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world. Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains. Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment. Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

title: Manager - Government Business (Ophthalmology)
description:
1. Job Purpose Drive business growth, strategic account development and market penetration of the companys ophthalmology portfolio across Central and State Government institutions, public healthcare organizations and institutional procurement agencies. The role combines government business development, tender and procurement management, key account ownership, stakeholder engagement, commercial performance and order execution. The incumbent will build a qualified business pipeline, develop long-term institutional relationships and deliver revenue, profitability and market-penetration objectives. 
 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 A. Government Business Development & Institutional Sales • Develop and execute government business strategies, annual operating plans and revenue forecasts for the ophthalmology portfolio. • Identify and assess opportunities across Central and State Government healthcare institutions, government hospitals, medical colleges, public-sector healthcare organizations and specialist eye-care institutions. • Map target institutions, evaluate business potential and develop account plans covering product requirements, procurement cycles, stakeholders and revenue opportunities. • Drive institutional sales, new account acquisition, product empanelment, formulary inclusion, and account growth. • Identify government-funded healthcare programmes, procurement opportunities and avenues for market expansion. B. Tender Management, Procurement & Government Liaising • Identify and evaluate tenders through GeM, CPPP, State Medical Services Corporation portals and institutional procurement platforms. • Manage the complete tender lifecycle, including bid/no-bid assessment, eligibility review, technical and commercial documentation, submission, pre-bid meetings, clarifications, negotiations, award and contract execution. • Coordinate with Regulatory, Quality, Finance, Legal and Supply Chain teams for licenses, registrations, certifications, EMDs, performance bank guarantees and other tender requirements. • Liaise with relevant government departments, procurement authorities, tender committees and institutional officials regarding tender processes, approvals, empanelment and purchase orders. • Drive government rate contracts, institutional empanelment and purchase agreements while ensuring compliance with procurement rules and contractual obligations. • Track tender outcomes, competitor participation, pricing and unsuccessful bids to improve future conversion rates. C. Key Account, Stakeholder & Channel Partner Management • Build and maintain strategic relationships with institutional leadership, deans, directors, medical superintendents, hospital administrators, ophthalmologists, purchase heads, procurement officers and other relevant decision-makers. • Develop stakeholder engagement plans based on institutional hierarchies, approval processes, procurement workflows and budget cycles. • Conduct institutional visits, scientific product presentations, technical discussions and periodic business reviews to support product evaluation and adoption. • Understand clinical requirements, product preferences, consumption patterns and institutional service expectations; maintain updated stakeholder databases and engagement records. • Identify, appoint and manage distributors and channel partners for government business, ensuring effective tender participation, product availability, order fulfilment and collections. • Monitor distributor performance, inventory, service levels and contractual compliance, and resolve supply and service escalations. D. Commercial Management, Order Execution & Business Performance • Own assigned government business revenue, sales growth and profitability targets; prepare annual business plans, quarterly forecasts and monthly projections. • Evaluate tender pricing, competitor quotations, gross margins, account contribution, working-capital requirements and commercial risks within approved pricing and delegation-of-authority frameworks. • Monitor purchase orders, sales orders, invoicing, delivery commitments, payment realisation and outstanding receivables in coordination with Finance. • Coordinate with Supply Chain & Logistics team to ensure timely product availability, dispatch, delivery acknowledgement and contractual compliance. • Track institutional consumption, replenishment requirements, product-quality experiences and customer feedback, ensuring timely resolution. • Maintain accurate records of tenders, contracts, rate agreements, purchase orders and account performance; submit periodic business reports highlighting revenue, pipeline, collections, risks and corrective actions. E. Portfolio Development, Market Intelligence, Team Coordination, Leadership & Compliance • Drive institutional business for the ophthalmology portfolio by understanding product specifications, clinical requirements, competitive positioning and institutional procurement needs. • Monitor government procurement trends, competitor products, pricing, tender outcomes and market developments; identify portfolio gaps, new-product opportunities and potential registrations or empanelment. • Share market intelligence and institutional feedback with senior management, Marketing, Product Management, Regulatory and other relevant teams to support business strategy. • Lead and develop the government business team, where applicable, by defining territories, account ownership, targets and performance expectations; conduct periodic reviews and build capabilities in institutional sales, tender management and stakeholder engagement. • Collaborate closely with the field sales and sales management teams to align government business initiatives, strengthen market coverage, leverage field-level insights and drive better outcomes through coordinated efforts. • Ensure compliance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations, government procurement rules, tender conditions, contractual obligations and company policies. • Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready documentation; ensure ethical and transparent engagement with government officials and healthcare professionals, adhering to applicable anti-bribery, anti-corruption and compliance requirements. • Identify commercial, contractual, regulatory and operational risks and coordinate with Legal, Regulatory and Compliance teams to implement appropriate mitigation measures.

description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here 
 
 PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world s most pressing health challenges. 
 Location: Shillong- Meghalaya 
 Type: Third-Party Contract (11 months, aligned to project duration until Sep 2027) with possibility of extension 
 
 PATH is seeking Program Officer - Supply Chain Management position for implementation and roll out of the supply chain strengthening project under HSS vertical. This position will work with the national and state teams to provide technical assistance and hand-holding support for strengthening supply chain in the state of Meghalaya. 
 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Procurement Planning and Supply Chain Strengthening - Assist MMDSL in preparation of annual procurement plans for medical supplies, pharmaceuticals, and health-related services, provide necessary support to MMDSL to manage the end-to-end procurement cycle, including bid preparation, vendor management and supply management. - Contributes to designing and implementing interventions aimed at optimizing procurement processes and enhancing supply chain efficiency within the healthcare system in Meghalaya, while adhering to government procurement principles and guidelines - Support MMDSL in the development of procurement strategies for health commodities alignment with state and national guidelines. - Work closely with the Department of Health Service (DHS) to strengthen the supply chain at the facility level and support in establishing periodic performance monitoring systems. - Support in the implementation of state-specific roadmaps for To-Be supply chain model for Meghalaya, focusing on strengthening procurement processes. - Collaborate with national and state teams to support the integration and execution of state-specific project activities related to procurement and supply chain management, ensuring alignment with MMDSL and NHM guidelines and standards. - Coordinate with various competent committees, such as the technical committee, procurement committee, and Quality Assurance Committee of MMDSL. 
 Project Coordination : - Support in coordinating with project partners and intervention states on a day-to-day basis to monitor progress and facilitate the rollout of activities in accordance with approved work plans/proposals, ensuring alignment with state-specific roadmap and government procurement principles. - Take lead and assist in the development of various technical resources, project documents, and reports related to procurement and supply chain management to support the implementation of the To-Be models for Meghalaya State. 
 Capacity Building, Innovation, and Best Practices 
 - Contribute to the development and delivery of training programs for external and internal stakeholders on procurement processes, supply chain management, LMIS usage, and government procurement principles, tailored to the requirements of the state-specific roadmap implementation. - Support in identifying capacity-building needs and opportunities to enhance supply chain management, assist MMDSL in establishing model drug warehouses with WMS integration and implement innovation such as barcoding etc. - Scout for innovative technology solutions to address challenges related to SCM, and in concurrence with key stakeholders, pilot test innovative interventions in selected intervention geographies, closely monitoring outcomes and lessons learned to inform future interventions and scale-up efforts. 
 Government Liaisin g: 
 - Establish and maintain effective communication channels with relevant government agencies and stakeholders at the national, state, and local levels. - Liaise with government officials to ensure alignment of project activities with government priorities and policies, facilitating collaboration and leveraging government resources and support. Collaboration and Integration: - Work closely with various team members for the integration and implementation of project activities related to warehouse operations promptly, ensuring cross-functional collaboration and synergy. - Assist the Program lead in coordinating and executing program partnerships and related program work, fostering collaboration both internally within PATH and with external stakeholders. 
 Project Management: 
 - Support in coordinating project management processes internally within PATH and with external stakeholders, ensuring adherence to project timelines and deliverables outlined in the state-specific roadmaps. - Provide regular updates and reports on project progress, including achievements, challenges, and lessons learned, contributing to ongoing monitoring and evaluation efforts. - Undertake other tasks which may be assigned from time to time by the supervisor - Available to travel to intervention states up to 30-40% of the time. 
 
 Required Experience and qualifications 
 - Postgraduate /Professional degree in Pharmacy/Logistics and Supply Chain Management/ MBA-SCM MPH/MHA/ MBA-Finance or any other related field. - Minimum 4-5 years of experience in supply chain management in reputed public or private organization - Previous experience/ Demonstrated expertise in a similar role would be preferred for this position. - Expertise in functions and practices of supply chain in government organizations/ departments and knowledge of best practices in supply chain management. - Technical knowledge and field experience in planning and implementation of logistics and supply chain programs. Skills/ Abilities - Self-starter and committed to performing their duties with a high degree of autonomy in line with project goals and objectives. - Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and policy concepts to diverse audiences. - Self-directed and creative individual with experience managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders. - Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and project management skills - Excellent organizational and project management skills - Ability to multitask and work in a multi-cultural team. - Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines - Ability to travel up to 40-50% of the time.

description:

Location: Kerala, Delhi, Kolkata 
Reports to: Category Head 
 About the Role Savomart is looking for a seasoned commercial leader who has sat on the other side of the table and now wants to build category and vendor strength from within a retailer. You will own the FMCG category P&L (foods, home care, personal care), negotiate and run joint business plans with large suppliers, and use your field-level understanding of trade, distributors and in-store execution to lift sales, margin and availability across Savomart stores. This role suits someone with 15–20+ years in FMCG sales, modern trade and category management who knows how brands plan, price, promote and distribute, and can convert that knowledge into a sharper buying and merchandising engine for a regional retailer. 
 What You Will Own
1. Category P&L and growth own sales, gross margin and inventory health for FMCG categories (detergents, personal care, packaged foods and beverages). Build annual and quarterly category plans with SKU store-cluster level action plans. Drive growth of high-potential and future core segments and rationalize slow-moving SKUs.
2. Vendor and key account partnerships Lead annual trade terms, joint business plans, scheme negotiations and listing/delisting decisions with national and regional FMCG suppliers. Manage relationships at senior level with sales heads, key account managers and distributors of leading FMCG companies. Ensure timely claims, scheme settlement and funding of promotions.
3. Promotions, visibility and in-store execution Plan the promotional calendar with suppliers, including launches, displays, endcaps, POSM and store activations. Track planogram compliance, share of shelf, on-shelf availability and visibility scores across stores. Run supplier-funded launches of new brand innovations through the store network.
4. Supply chain and availability work with supply chain and warehouse teams on demand forecasts, stock plans, fill rates and replenishment cycles. Reduce out-of-stocks and ageing inventory using sell-out and market data.
5. Insights and analytics Use sales data, panel data (Nielsen/IMRB-type market insights) and competitor tracking to set pricing, assortment and promotion decisions. Produce weekly and monthly category dashboards for leadership.
6. Team leadership Lead and develop category managers, buyers and merchandising executives. Upskill store and field teams on product knowledge, selling points and competitor offerings through sessions and store immersions.
7. Growth initiatives Support expansion into new stores and clusters, private label opportunities and supplier-backed exclusives. Where relevant, evaluate and onboard digital and AI-enabled tools for forecasting, pricing and promotion analytics.

 Company: Times Fibrefill Pvt. Ltd. Location: Maheshtala, South Kolkata, West Bengal Department: Stores & Inventory Employment Type: Full-Time Experience: Minimum 2 years of total work experience(preffered) 
 Job Summary : Times Fibrefill Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a responsible and organized Store Assistant to support daily store operations, inventory management, material handling, documentation, and coordination with production and other departments. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, ensuring timely material issuance, and supporting the smooth movement of raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods. 
 Key Responsibilities : 1. Store & Inventory Management - Assist in receiving, storing, issuing, and dispatching materials. Maintain accurate stock records for raw materials, WIP, and finished goods. Monitor stock levels and inform the Store Supervisor about shortages or excess inventory. Conduct regular physical stock counts and assist in reconciling discrepancies. Ensure proper labeling, categorization, and storage of materials to prevent damage or loss. Issue fiber bales, WIP, and finished goods as per authorized requirements. 2. Material Handling & Documentation - Assist in preparing and maintaining material challans, stock registers, and other store-related documents. Verify incoming and outgoing materials against invoices, challans, and supporting documents. Support the preparation of Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) for received materials. Maintain proper records of material receipts, issues, returns, and transfers. Ensure all documentation is updated and properly filed. 3. Production Coordination - Coordinate with the production team for timely issuance of raw materials and WIP. Support production planning by ensuring the availability of required materials. Follow up with the Store Supervisor regarding material shortages and urgent requirements. Assist in maintaining proper stock of production materials and finished goods. 4. Quality & Vendor Coordination - Assist in checking incoming materials for quantity, visible damage, and discrepancies. Report defective, damaged, or incorrect materials to the Store Supervisor immediately. Support the segregation and return of defective materials to suppliers as instructed. Coordinate with the relevant team for material replacement and corrective action. 5. Finished Goods & Dispatch Support - Assist in maintaining finished goods inventory and proper storage. Support packing, carton checking, and preparation of packing lists before dispatch. Verify material quantities against dispatch documents and challans. Coordinate with the dispatch and merchandising teams to ensure timely shipment preparation. Report any mismatch or discrepancy to the Store Supervisor before dispatch. 6. Store Organization & Safety - Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and proper arrangement of the store. Follow company procedures for safe material handling and storage. Ensure materials are stored in designated locations and are easily traceable. Support periodic stock audits and other store-related activities assigned by management. 
 Required Skills & Competencies : Basic knowledge of inventory management and store operations. Ability to maintain stock registers and basic documentation. Basic computer knowledge, particularly MS Excel, is preferred. Good coordination and communication skills. Attention to detail and accuracy in stock counting. Ability to handle materials responsibly and work in a team. 
 Experience & Qualifications : Minimum 1-2 years of total work experience required. Previous experience in a Garments industry store, warehouse, manufacturing unit, or factory environment is preferred. Graduation/Diploma preferred. Experience in handling raw materials, WIP, and finished goods will be an advantage. Interested candidates with relevant store or warehouse experience are encouraged to apply. at - hr@timesfiberfill.com

The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Canadian corporate taxation, particularly in areas involving owner-managed businesses, Canadian-controlled private corporations (CCPCs), corporate reorganizations, and shareholder taxation. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring the ability to independently review complex tax returns, provide practical tax planning recommendations, manage client relationships, and mentor a team of tax professionals. The Tax Manager will work closely with senior leadership to ensure technical accuracy, maintain high-quality client service, strengthen internal tax processes, and support the continued growth of One Accounting's tax practice. Key Responsibilities 1. Tax Compliance and Reporting Review complex Canadian corporate income tax returns (T2), elections, and supporting calculations. Provide technical guidance on CCPC taxation, GRIP, RDTOH, CDA, dividend taxation, and shareholder remuneration. Identify tax risks, compliance issues, and planning opportunities. 2. Tax Planning and Business Advisory Advise on corporate reorganizations, section 85 rollovers, estate freezes, amalgamations, and shareholder transactions. Develop tax-efficient strategies for owner-managed businesses and private corporations. Support business acquisitions, succession planning, and corporate restructuring. 3. Tax Accounting and Financial Reporting Research complex Canadian tax matters and prepare technical memoranda and recommendations. Interpret tax legislation, CRA guidance, and relevant case law. Act as the primary technical resource for the firm's accounting team. 4. title: SENIOR ANALYST OPERATIONS - Service Desk
description:
Job Description 
 
 Senior Technical Support Specialist with Sift timing ( 4 PM IST to 1 AM IST) 
 Organization Assignments Area: BOCO Corporate Backoffice Company: FleetPride, Inc. Cost Center: 902 IT Shared Services Division: Branch Operation Region: Corporate Sales Territory: None Supervisory Organization Rick Anderson Job Details Employee Type Schedule A Job Profile Job Profile: Service Desk Technical Support Specialist II Job Title Senior Technical Support Specialist Business Title Senior Technical Support Specialist Time Type Full Time Location Corporate Pay Information Pay Rate Type: Hourly Job Exempt: No Management Level Individual Contributor Working Time Default Weekly Hours: 40 Location Weekly Hours: 40 Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 FTE: 100% Work Shift (Empty) Job Description This position is responsible for providing the highest quality hardware and software support to all FLEETPRIDE locations and employees. This position will be a member of the IT Services Group and report to the Manager of IT Support Services. The primary duty is to handle incoming queries and help with requests from all end users, either via email or over the phone. The candidate will be responsible for taking detailed notes of the problem the user is experiencing, determine steps they can take to resolve the issue, and manage the flow of incoming support requests. In addition, this person will be considered a (SME) Subject Matter Expert for most if not all IT functions or processes. This person will be highly technical and will provide a higher level of technical support to issues where other analysts are unable to resolve or in cases where vendor involvement is required. This person will attempt to duplicate problems and define root causes, using product designs, code, or specifications. This person will be an active member of the Service Desk Improvement team. This person will generally be utilized as a project lead and provide additional oversight of KPIs that drive the performance of the service desk. Duties & Responsibilities Receives and handles incoming requests for services following agreed procedures. Allocates and prioritizes calls promptly (initial triage). Logs incidents and service requests and maintains relevant records. Identifies and classifies incident types and service interruptions. Records incidents cataloging them by symptom and resolution. Acts under guidance to record and track reliability data for services. Escalates complex or unresolved incidents. Systematically interprets user problems and identifies solutions and possible side effects. Uses experience to address user problems and provides potential solutions. Records and tracks issues from outset to conclusion (Problem Management Team Member). During change, acts systematically to respond to day-to-day operational needs, avoiding service disruptions and maintaining coherence to SLA and information security requirements. Responds to common requests for service by providing information to enable fulfillment. Promptly allocates unresolved calls as appropriate. Maintains records, informs users about the process, and advises relevant persons of actions taken. Acts as the routine contact point, receiving and handling requests for Level 3 support. Responds to a broad range of service requests for support by providing information to fulfill requests or enable resolution. Provides first-line investigation and diagnosis and promptly allocates unresolved issues as appropriate. Assists with the development of standards and applies these to track, monitor, report, resolve, or escalate issues. Contributes to creation of support documentation such as knowledge articles, process flow diagrams or procedures, and RACI charts. Maintains a high level of system support and client satisfaction to end users at all times. Supports, monitors, tests, and troubleshoots user and system-related hardware and software problems and escalates as appropriate. Self-trains and self-educates to better support the technology FleetPride uses to support operations locally and at the branches. Assists or trains others on systems and features. Provides timely attention to all Service Desk requests, ensuring tickets are complete, impact and criticality are assessed, and issues are resolved or escalated appropriately. Performs daily ticket maintenance and management and ensures requestors stay informed. Works with third-party systems and hardware providers to diagnose and address issues. Plans, prepares, and coordinates maintenance windows for updates, upgrades, and patches. Maintains, cleans, repairs, upgrades, and replaces hardware as needed, processes RMAs, and ensures technology availability. Pays special attention to time-sensitive business requests and minimizes user/customer impact. Provides basic user account maintenance across all FleetPride systems. Performs tier-one support on office equipment and business productivity tools. Works with other team members on desktop/laptop images and deployed software. Makes pragmatic recommendations on system and process enhancements. Ensures configurations, system features, and site information are documented, especially for branches. Establishes and maintains thorough knowledge of organization and technology standards. Responsible for communicating, promoting, and adhering to IT standards. Assists with controlling hardware, software, and telephone inventory. Education & Training High School diploma Minimum of 5 years experience in Service Desk Bachelors degree in relevant technical field preferred MCSE, MCSA, MCITP, A+, or equivalent desktop certifications preferred ITIL v3/v4 Foundations preferred but not required Knowledge & Experience High level of proficiency with Windows 7, Windows 10, and Microsoft Office Strong understanding of networking principles Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Professional written and oral communication and customer service skills Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize and multi-task 3+ years providing IT customer training and mentoring 3+ years of application support experience 3+ years supporting POS systems, payment processing, timekeeping, and operational systems 3+ years supporting local and remote users in environments with 100+ users Ability to manage short-term and long-term goals simultaneously Ability to raise issues proactively and in a timely manner Ability to work well in a team-oriented environment Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new systems Skills & Abilities Keyboarding skills and computer proficiency, including MS Office Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills Detail-oriented, organized, service-oriented, and responsible Strong customer service and presentation skills Ability to motivate self and team Willingness to accept ownership of IT systems to ensure 24x7 availability Ability to analyze user needs and reach acceptable solutions Ability to work independently or as part of a team Knowledge of POS systems, printers, peripherals, desktops/laptops, and PC applications Practical knowledge of intranet, internet, servers, networking, and telephony Network troubleshooting knowledge including TCP/IP, VLANs, and wireless Experience working with managed service providers Ability to maintain confidentiality Knowledge of security and compliance practices Working Conditions Work Environment Typical office environment with ambient room temperatures, lighting, and standard office equipment Physical Demands Reaching above shoulder height, below the waist, and lifting throughout the workday Long periods of sitting or standing while working at a computer Occasional lifting of items up to 50 pounds Ability to work through stressful situations May require overtime, weekend work, and overnight travel Extended time viewing a computer monitor and using a keyboard Additional Notes This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed. The employee will be required to follow other instructions and perform other duties as requested by their supervisor.

You will drive process and performance improvement to meet or exceed customer expectations. You will focus on the team to provide enthusiastic support, which includes analyzing root-cause issues and solutions rather than addressing transactional support issues and hold staff accountable to consistent process and improved performance. Clinisys' AI Philosophy Building an AIfirst organisation is central to Clinisys purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AIenabled, cloudbased platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. title: Graphic Designer - Web, Branding & PowerPoint
description:
About us We are a US based insurance agency. We help small business owners start retirement plans using the tax credits created by the SECURE 2.0 Act, and we help them with their health, life and disability benefits. Business owners arrive from LinkedIn, use a calculator, and book a call with the founder. Every page has one job: get them to book. We need a designer who can do two things well. Design the website that does that job. And design the presentation decks the founder uses in front of business owners and insurance carriers. You will work with the founder and with a developer who builds in WordPress Gutenberg blocks. You design; he implements. You will not be expected to write code. What you will design Website pages. Landing pages, calculator pages, an about page, trust and licence pages. Desktop and mobile for every one. Conversion focused, one clear action per page, fast to load. The brand. Take a chosen logo concept and produce proper vector files, a small brand sheet with the palette and type scale, and the social profile assets. Presentation decks. Sales decks for business owners, carrier and FMO decks, and a reusable PowerPoint template the founder can edit himself without breaking it. Lead magnets. One or two short PDF guides, laid out properly. Social graphics for LinkedIn. Post images and a banner. Email templates. Simple, on brand, readable on a phone. Must have Strong Figma skills. You work in Figma, not just export images from it. A portfolio of real web or landing page work with a conversion goal behind it. Genuine PowerPoint ability, including master slides and a template someone else can edit. Confident typography and layout. You can hold a hierarchy together. Mobile first thinking. You design the 375 pixel version properly, not as an afterthought. Adobe Illustrator for vector work. Good to have Branding and logo design experience with delivered vector files. Financial, insurance or B2B experience. Basic accessibility awareness, particularly colour contrast. HTML and CSS literacy, enough to talk to a developer without friction. Familiarity with WordPress Gutenberg block constraints. Details Experience: 2 to 5 years. Strong portfolio matters more than years. Location: Remote, with at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern time. This is a part time ,freelance Job, you keep your existing job!

title: IT Analyst Applications
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a skilled IT Analyst Applications to join India CoE-Integration Engg - CAT IT Division . The Data Integration Engineer is responsible for the design, development, integration, monitoring and support of Commercial Account platforms. This role will partner with Cat Financial's IT teams to deliver scalable data solutions, API integrations, and analytics capabilities. The successful candidate will leverage modern data engineering technologies including Dataiku, Snowflake, Python, SQL, GitHub, GitHub Copilot, and API-based architectures to enhance platform stability, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic digital transformation initiatives. This role serves as a technical expert for data integration and platform modernization efforts, ensuring global solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore - Caterpillar PSN .

Support production operations, monitoring, issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Support and maintain secure, scalable API integrations, and event-driven architectures-by monitoring performance, troubleshooting issues, ensuring compliance, and coordinating integrations across Commercial Account platforms. 

 Data Engineering Analytics 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Dataiku, Python, and SQL. Build and optimize enterprise data solutions utilizing Snowflake as the primary cloud data platform. Implement data quality controls, monitoring, and governance processes. Support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives through curated datasets and reusable data products. 

 Software Development Automation 
 Utilize GitHub and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, testing, and deployment activities. Develop automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. Apply DevOps and CI/CD best practices to ensure reliable releases and platform stability. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, support procedures, and knowledge articles.

Experience integrating with third-party platforms and SaaS applications. Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and data governance principles. Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud services. Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies. Experience supporting globally distributed users and business processes.

2) Operate and monitor CNC machines
3) Look after the tools and components conform to engineering drawings and specifications. 
 Points to be noted. 
1) You will undergo a one-year training period, followed by a six-month probation period.
2) Immediate joiners are required.

 Company Overview- Endurance Technologies Ltd 
 
 About Us

 Role: Senior Saviynt IAM Engineer Location: Pune Experience: 8 to 12 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment 
 What You'll Do:

Configure and manage access request workflows, role-based access controls, certifications, and attestation processes within Saviynt. Develop and customize connectors, workflows, rules, and provisioning processes to support business requirements. Design and support identity lifecycle management processes, including Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows. Integrate Saviynt with enterprise platforms such as Active Directory, Azure AD, Okta, Workday, ServiceNow, AWS, and other cloud applications. Implement and support Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust security frameworks.
